cs.t: I recently bought one of the Star Lites from these guys:  https://starlabs.systems  Very nice machine so far.  My only real complaint is the trackpad. Coming from years of Macs and a Pixelbook, it was a shock to the fingers. The 13 inch machine has a glass touchpad, so presumably that’s not a complaint there. Either way, reasonable price, works well, arrived very quickly.
